title: DETAIL OF ROOF AND ATTIC

texts.text: This architectural drawing sheet details the roof and attic structure of the Iolani Palace in Honolulu, Hawaii, featuring cross-sections, elevations, and plans that illustrate materials like steel framing, concrete slabs, wood shingles, and copper elements.
